description: Amendment register of the frozen Phase 493 neutrality pins (saldo-boundary-neutrality-493.test.ts). The frozen literals in that file are never edited; a month-saldo cell whose expected value changed ON PURPOSE is named here, and the test applies the register to a deep copy of the frozen pin. Every other value is still compared strictly against the frozen literal. Same mechanism as contexts/time-tracking/__tests__/fixtures/day-break-equivalence-80-amendments.json.
rule: The cumulative series of an open month (GET /overtime/month-saldo days[].cumulativeSaldoMinutes) starts at openMonthCarryInMinutes(): the last closed month plus every unclosed month since then (the fixture has no closed month, so every month since the hire date).
reason: Gesamtsaldo eines offenen Monats enthält alle offenen Monate seit dem letzten Abschluss; gleich dem Live-Saldo, der in derselben Datei gepinnt ist (LIVE_BALANCE_HOURS at 2026-03-02: F -931.03 h = -55862 min, M -210.8 h = -12648 min = the amended February lastDayCumulative). The pinned values encoded Issue #681: each open month restarted at 0. Only the two cumulative fields move; worked/expected/balance, report figures, the live balance and stored snapshots are unchanged.
